Download

You can find our code on github. Please reach out if you are interested in trying it in your area. (You don’t have to contact us before hand, but we would love to learn about your experience.)

We are starting an open beta test of our apps. You need to install the DDD Client and DDD K9 Email apps on the end users’ phones. The DDD Transport application will be installed on phone that is moving between the connected and disconnected areas.

Using the “App Share” tab in the DDD transport application, transports can download and transport the client apps to disconnected areas, where they can be installed by the clients. See Getting started for more info.
